label: VP1840 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a VP1840-family locus represented by the DefenseFinder VP1840__VP1840 custom HMM profile and experimentally linked to reduced vibriophage plaquing when the cloned Vibrio parahaemolyticus RIMD 2210633 vp1840 cassette is expressed from a VSV105 plasmid.
observations: Phage-defense branch under phage defense system; distinct from the Vp1840 source locus tag, the VP_RS08920 locus tag, the individual WP_005483293.1 protein, the VP1840 HMM profile row, VSV105 plasmid-expression assays, vibriophage fold-change assay rows, PSI-BLAST homolog rows, the absent VP1840 rule-level DefenseFinder model, unresolved VP1840 component activity and phage readouts, and other integron-encoded or phage-defense systems.
